chapter: South Side scene and Bunk Johnson
title: Playing with Bunk Johnson on North Broadway in 1945-46
summary: Rinker recalls being asked to sit in with Bunk Johnson, Darnell Howard and Don Ewell at a short North Side engagement, and what Bunk's early New Orleans style meant.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I'd like to have. You said the spot on North Broadway. Someplace around. In Argyle. That would make it a place that he played for a few nights. Yes.
